_comment: Design freeze F4 (user decision 2026-11-03, docs/DESIGN_FREEZE.ko.md): leg 0.80 m, ostrich ratio, knee fold 2.6. Same modules as rev3_b.json; leg segments, knee four-bar and hip pitch belt from the F1 shape screen (evidence 193, modeling/shape_scan_r03.py). Model rev 3 axis config (stage 0, option B, user decision 2026-10-31; docs/evidence/186-stage0-design-b, 187-stage0-rev3-model). ONE source for RunEnv(model_rev=3) (actuator limits, PD gains, armature, four-bar, masses) and checked against realism_robstride_rev3.json by tests/test_rev3_model.py. ratio = external stage, motor rad per joint rad (< 1 = speed-up belt); link_efficiency 0.9 for a belt or linkage, 1 for direct drive. mount = MJCF body that carries module + drive_kg (pelvis modules ride on the hip-roll link). drive_kg = belts / four-bar / yaw bracket, ASSUMED (no design). The ankle pitch follows the knee 1:1 (no motor), the ankle roll is locked (arch8).

hip_yaw.why: estimated turning load 25 N·m at 8 rad/s (evidence 186); belt 0.10 kg + bracket 0.05 kg

hip_roll.why: peak GRF x 0.10 m; with the 1.5 belt the RMS exceeds the rated torque (x1.43)

hip_pitch.why: speed-up belt 0.70: best belt of the F1 screen for the 0.80 m leg (design stride with the stance hip term, x1.2, module speed x1 and x0.9)

knee_pitch.why: module on the upper femur, four-bar below (N 0.62-2.15 over the knee band)

fourbar.why: F1 (evidence 193): best of 20,000 random four-bars on the 0.17 m femur whose band (both transmission angles >= 30 deg) covers the running knee range and the fold 2.6: band 0.616-2.807, score 1.00 (design x1.2, module speed x1/x0.9)

leg.why: F1 (evidence 193): sum 0.80 m, ostrich ratio 1 : 1.89 : 1.82; hip 11.1 m/s 0.84, knee (fold 2.6) 1.00, prone belly clearance 8 cm (calculation)
